title: Grenslan v0.1 public Tool Contract schemas (TC-057 adopted)
description: Registry with shared definitions. Validate a tool input/output by selecting the corresponding $ref and carrying the registry $defs. This registry is not itself a tool input schema.

web_search.description: Discover attributable sources using normalized search providers.

image_search.description: Discover image sources without automatically fetching originals.

web_open.description: Acquire one URL or an authorized bounded batch.

web_read.description: Read bounded content from an existing captured resource.

web_find.description: Locate text in an existing captured web representation.

web_links.description: List discovered links from captured content.

web_traverse.description: Traverse authorized links within explicit bounded scope.

browser_session_create.description: Create an isolated authorized ephemeral browser session.

browser_navigate.description: Navigate a browser session within authorized destinations.

browser_observe.description: Observe the authorized page state and bounded structured elements.

browser_interact.description: Apply one authorized typed action to a current page state.

browser_screenshot.description: Capture a bounded page, viewport, region or element image.

browser_session_close.description: Close an authorized session without deleting separately retained artifacts.

document_open.description: Acquire or register an authorized document and identify its format.

document_read.description: Read selected document content using an available processing method.

document_find.description: Find exact or explicitly requested regex content within selected scope.

document_tables.description: Extract structured cells and preserve table relationships and uncertainty.

document_render.description: Render selected document pages, slides or regions as derived artifacts.

document_media.description: Extract supported embedded objects without executing them.

image_open.description: Acquire an authorized image and preserve original bytes.

image_inspect.description: Inspect image characteristics and optionally request attributed interpretation.

image_transform.description: Create a bounded immutable derived image.

image_ocr.description: Extract visible source-language text with locations and uncertainty.

artifact_get.description: Return an authorized artifact descriptor, bounded content or download route.

source_verify.description: Independently retrieve, compare captures or verify retained artifact integrity.

quotation_verify.description: Check a quotation deterministically against the selected available representation.

citation_get.description: Resolve a capture-specific citation or construct one from a retained artifact locator.

capabilities_get.description: Report authorized tool and provider capabilities and limitations.

operation_status.description: Inspect an authorized operation and actual progress.

operation_results.description: Retrieve authorized bounded available operation output.

operation_cancel.description: Request authorized scoped cancellation without discarding available partial results.

amendment: TC-057 accepted: explicit optional translation and model-assisted OCR, material configuration attribution. No other definitions or tools changed.
